jobs.occupation: PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) in Heidelberg, starting in January 2027, is offering PhD Positions in Agentic AI for Medical Image Analysis.The Division of Medical Image Computing (MIC) is recruiting PhD candidates to develop AI agents that interpret medical images, use analysis tools, evaluate intermediate results, and adapt their approach based on evidence and feedback.Candidates will join a collaborative research environment with clinical partners, extensive computing infrastructure, and connections to initiatives such as Helmholtz Imaging.Your TasksWe investigate how AI agents can combine medical images with clinical information, plan and execute analytical steps, learn from feedback, assess intermediate results, and respond appropriately to uncertainty or failure. Approaches may include reinforcement learning, multimodal learning, vision-language models, planning, tool-augmented language models, probabilistic modelling, and classical medical image analysis.Candidates may work primarily in one of several application areas:1. multimodal agents for prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment support;2. auditable analysis of longitudinal imaging for tumour-response assessment;3. federated multimodal agents connecting oral imaging with systemic health information; or4. or reinforcement learning for agents that navigate and integrate complex data across medical and other scientific domains.The individual PhD topic will be developed jointly based on the candidate’s interests, expertise, and the methodological questions arising across these applications.You will:- develop agents that combine medical images with clinical text and other information;- investigate reinforcement learning for planning, tool use, feedback integration, and iterative improvement;- apply agentic methods to segmentation, annotation, quantitative analysis, or scientific data exploration;- establish rigorous evaluation methods covering accuracy, robustness, generalisation, uncertainty calibration, failure detection, and appropriate abstention; and- collaborate with methodological and clinical researchers, publish your results, and contribute reusable software or benchmarks.Your ProfileYou should have:- A master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline- A strong foundation in machine learning and strong Python programming skills- Practical experience with a deep-learning framework such as PyTorch- Experience in at least one relevant area, such as reinforcement learning, computer vision, language models, multimodal learning, or medical-image analysis- An analytical and collaborative working style and good communication skills in EnglishPrevious experience with medical data is helpful but not required. We also welcome candidates with strong machine-learning fundamentals who want to develop expertise in agentic AI.What you can excpect:- Scientific freedom to develop your own methodological research question- Close supervision and exchange within a cohort of PhD researchers- Access to extensive GPU infrastructure, medical-imaging resources, and established research software- Collaboration with international machine-learning and clinical partners- Support for conference participation, open-source contributions, and professional development- Fully funded PhD submissionPlease submit:- your CV- academic transcripts- a brief research statement of no more than one page describing a question in agentic AI that interests you- your preferred application area, or a ranking of the available areas- your master’s thesis or another representative piece of scientific work- links to relevant publications, software, or code repositories, if available- Instead of a generic motivation letter, please use your research statement to explain which scientific question you would like to investigate, why it matters, and how you might approach itWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- Access to international research networks- Doctoral salary with the usual social benefits- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted training and mentoring through the DKFZ International PhD Program and DKFZ Career Service- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Constantin Ulrich HarsyPhone: +49 (0) 6221/42-3552Duration: The positions are initially limited to 3 years.Application Deadline: December 2, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

Job Description About Kapaya Most organizations do not struggle with ambition. They struggle with execution.Processes are often spread across disconnected tools, manual work slows teams down, and important operational workflows are not always designed to scale.That is where Kapaya comes in.We help organizations improve how work gets done by designing better operational structures, building connected systems and implementing workflows that are clear, practical and scalable. Using tools such as Airtable, Make and AI-enabled workflows, we help customers move from complexity to clarity.Kapaya is part of One Productivity Group, a pan-European group focused on improving how organizations operate. Across our brands, consulting, technology and execution come together to create better workflows, stronger collaboration and more scalable operations. About the role This role is for someone who enjoys translating complexity into practical systems.As a Solution Engineer, you work with customers who want to improve the way their operations are structured and delivered. The starting point is often a workflow that has grown over time, depends on manual work, or is spread across too many disconnected tools. Your role is to understand that setup, identify what can be improved and build solutions that make operations more effective and scalable.The role combines analysis, solution design, implementation and customer guidance. Software Engineering Experience: Several years of hands-on and architectural experience in software engineering (e.g., Python, Java, C#, JS/TS, or similar).• Applied AI Depth: Proven, independent Comfortable representing SQUER independently to customers with a high degree of professionalism.• Languages: Fluency in German and English.Your Benefits Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:• Ownership & jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Robotics Experte; Fernsteuerer/in (Robotik); Roboterbediener/in; KI-Trainer/inStellenbeschreibung:DeutschBerufsbezeichnung: Teleoperator / Teleoperatorin (m/w/d) – Robotersteuerung per VR (Praktikum mit Option auf Festanstellung)Über unsWir entwickeln die Technologie, mit der Roboter in der echten Welt sehen, verstehen und handeln können – in Lagern und Fabriken, nicht im Labor. Unsere Mission: die Lücken schließen, an denen klassische Automatisierung scheitert.Deine AufgabeDu steuerst Roboter über ein VR-Headset und hilfst so dabei, ihnen beizubringen, wie man Aufgaben in der echten Welt erledigt. Konkret:- Roboter per VR-Headset fernsteuern und dabei hochwertige Bewegungsdaten erzeugen- Bild- und Sensordaten sichten und mit hoher Sorgfalt kennzeichnen (Labeling)- Einfache, vorgegebene Abläufe am PC ausführen (wir zeigen dir genau, wie)- Auffälligkeiten dokumentieren: was ist passiert, was hättest du erwartet, wann genau- Enger Austausch mit einem kleinen, eingespielten TeamWas du mitbringen solltest- Keine Vorerfahrung nötig – wir bringen dir alles bei, was du für den Job brauchst- Gute Deutsch- oder gute Englischkenntnisse (mündlich und schriftlich)- Ruhige Hand, gutes Auge fürs Detail und Geduld bei sich wiederholenden Aufgaben- Grundlegende PC-Kenntnisse (E-Mails schreiben, Dateien verwalten reicht völlig)- Lust, dich in eine neue, ungewöhnliche Tätigkeit einzuarbeiten- Räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und gutes Reaktionsvermögen sind hilfreich – wer gern zockt, bringt hier oft schon ein gutes Gespür für Steuerung und Timing mit- Zuverlässigkeit und pünktliches ErscheinenWo und wieStuttgart-Vaihingen, vor Ort (kein Homeoffice möglich, da mit der Technik vor Ort gearbeitet wird).Art der Stelle & VerdienstStart als Praktikum, max. 6 Monate, Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche), 2.500 € brutto/Monat. Nach erfolgreichem Praktikum ist ein Einstieg in eine Festanstellung möglich, mit Verdienstmöglichkeiten von bis zu 65.000 € brutto/Jahr, abhängig von Erfahrung und Übernahme von Verantwortung.BewerbungBitte sende uns deinen Lebenslauf. Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht nötig – schreib uns stattdessen kurz, warum du Lust auf die Stelle hast.Unser Ablauf1. Bewerbung (Lebenslauf + kurze Nachricht)2. Schnuppertag vor Ort: Du lernst das Team kennen und bearbeitest gemeinsam eine reale Aufgabe aus dem Arbeitsalltag, um ein echtes Gefühl für die Stelle zu bekommenEnglishJob title: Teleoperator (m/f/d) – Robot Control via VR (Internship with option to convert to full-time)Who We AreWe build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world – moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can't solve.Your RoleYou'll control robots through a VR headset, helping teach them how to carry out real-world tasks. Specifically:- Operate robots via a VR headset to generate high-quality movement data- Review and label visual and sensor data with care and precision- Carry out simple, well-defined tasks on the computer (we'll show you exactly how)- Document anything unusual: what happened, what you expected, and when- Work closely with a small, hands-on teamWhat You Should Bring- No prior experience required – we'll teach you everything you need for the job- Good German or good English skills (spoken and written)- A steady hand, good attention to detail, and patience with repetitive tasks- Basic computer skills (writing emails, managing files is plenty)- Willingness to learn a new and unusual kind of work- Good spatial awareness and reaction time are a plus – if you enjoy video games, you likely already have a feel for control and timing- Reliability and punctualityLocation & SetupStuttgart-Vaihingen, on-site (remote work isn't possible, as the role requires working with the hardware in person).Type of Role & PayStarts as an internship, max. 6 months, full-time (40 h/week), €2,500 gross/month. After a successful internship, there's an opportunity to move into a full-time position, with earning potential of up to €65,000 gross/year, depending on experience and responsibility taken on.How to ApplyPlease send us your CV. A formal cover letter isn't necessary – just tell us briefly why you're interested in the role.Our Interview Plan1. Application (CV + short message)2. On-site assessment day: meet the team and work through a real challenge similar to the day-to-day role, to get a genuine feel for the environmentErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Qualitätskontrolle (einfache Kontrolltätigkeit)

jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Ihre AufgabeSie übernehmen die Gesamtverantwortung für eine der operativ bedeutendsten Funktionen an unserem Standort Schnelldorf — die Leitung der gesamten Inbound- und Outbound-Logistik. In dieser Funktion gestalten Sie aktiv, wie Waren effizient, regelkonform und zuverlässig entlang einer komplexen internationalen Lieferkette bewegt werden. Sie führen ein Team von rund 45 Mitarbeitenden und tragen die Gesamtverantwortung für die Leistung der Logistikfunktion. Sie treiben die kontinuierliche Optimierung der Logistikprozesse voran — von Wareneingängen und Auslieferungen über die Gefahrgutabwicklung bis hin zur Zollabfertigung — und stellen dabei die vollständige Einhaltung aller relevanten Vorschriften sicher, einschließlich der Gefahrgutgesetzgebung und der Anforderungen an die Luftfrachtsicherheit. Sie fördern Digitalisierungsinitiativen, die die Arbeitsweise der Funktion modernisieren und nutzen SAP-basierte Systeme in den Bereichen Supply Chain Management, Order-to-Cash und Transport, um messbare Verbesserungen in Geschwindigkeit, Qualität und Kosteneffizienz zu erzielen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle innerhalb des Standorts und darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie eng mit Supply Chain Management, Lagerlogistik, Customer Service, Ländergesellschaften, Speditionen, Trade Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, Quality und Zoll zusammen. Ihre Fähigkeit, über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg zu führen und strategische Prioritäten in operative Exzellenz zu übersetzen, ist entscheidend für Ihren Erfolg in dieser Rolle.Wer Sie sind- Sie verfügen über mindestens 10 Jahre Führungserfahrung in vergleichbarem Umfang und können eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Leitung großer, funktionsübergreifender Logistikteams in einem internationalen Umfeld vorweisen- Sie haben einen Masterabschluss, bevorzugt in Logistik, Supply Chain Management oder Betriebswirtschaft, oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation, die durch umfangreiche Berufserfahrung gestützt wird- Sie bringen umfassende Expertise in der Inbound- und Outbound-Logistik, der Gefahrgutabwicklung sowie im Zollwesen mit, einschließlich tiefgehender Kenntnisse der relevanten Rechtsgrundlagen und der Anforderungen an die Luftfrachtsicherheit- Sie verfügen über fundierte SAP-Kenntnisse in den Modulen Supply Chain Management, Order-to-Cash und Transport sowie über ausgeprägte Erfahrung mit den zugehörigen Logistik-IT-Systemen und eine klare Affinität zur Digitalisierung- Sie haben ein solides Verständnis betriebswirtschaftlicher Zusammenhänge, organisatorischer Prozesse und arbeitsrechtlicher Grundlagen, das es Ihnen ermöglicht, Ihr Team sowohl operativ als auch in der Personalführung sicher zu leiten- Sie kommunizieren fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch auf Verhandlungsniveau und verfügen über nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Präsentation und Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Dienstleistern und Stakeholdern aus unterschiedlichen Kulturkreisen- Sie bringen eine kontinuierliche Lernbereitschaft mit, unterstützt durch Weiterbildungen in Personalführung und Kommunikation, und sind motiviert, die Menschen in Ihrem Umfeld weiterzuentwickelnWhat we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: Minimum qualifications:- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.- 8 years of technology related sales, business development, channel sales, or partner management experience.- Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support client relationship management in this regionPreferred qualifications:- Experience building business partnerships with enterprise Independent Software Vendors (ISV).- Experience selling enterprise software solutions through Cloud Marketplaces.- Experience working with, and managing, complex sales scenarios with multiple parties with differing goals.- Experience creating new sales motions to scale best practices.- Ability to work with customer engineers and customers' technical decision makers to secure a joint opportunity.About the JobThe Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.As an ISV Sales Specialist, you will support the jointGo-To-Market (GTM) success of Independent Software Vendor (ISV) partners, including generating, advancing, and closing co-sell opportunities alongside the Google Cloud field sales team through the Google Cloud Marketplace. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.Germany: €114000 - €116000 (EUR) + 66.67% bonus target + equity + benefitsLearn more about benefits at Google.- Build and grow relationships with existing ISV partners and customers by closing joint opportunities with Google cloud sales account teams and Google’s ecosystem.- Develop regional co-sell plans and sales motions for ISV partners, working closely with cross-functional teams, including sales, customer engineers, and services teams.- Drive sales plan achievement through ISV partner pipeline creation and reviews, ensuring sufficiency in pipeline creation, velocity, and win rate.- Work with ISV partners, Google Cloud Sales teams, and customers to support transactions through the Google Cloud Marketplace, including distributor and reseller supported transactions.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Business-Development-Management, Kundenberatung, -betreuung
